_purpose: SINGLE-CONFIG JOINT grid search. Selection metric is POOLED mAP@50 across ALL 13 conditions (results['overall']['mAP_50'] over the all-13 filter), applied UNIFORMLY. NEVER per-domain best-of. Supports the held-out single-config rebuttal claim.
_pooled_metric_note: grid_search_runner.run_single_experiment returns results['overall']['mAP_50']; with the all-13 dataset_subset.filters below, 'overall' IS the pooled-over-13 COCO metric. No runner change needed.
_base_config_override_warning: config/global_instance_Guassian.json ships with detector.threshold=0.75 and iou_threshold=0.1 (WRONG vs the paper operating point). This grid PINS detector.threshold=0.1 and detector.iou_threshold=0.7 via single-value grid_params so the search runs at the paper operating point. Do NOT remove these two entries.
_stack_note: MUST run under the pinned transformers==4.57.6 venv (slow image processor). A 5.x run is worthless. See build_narval_env.sh + narval_grid_search.sbatch.
